title: Practical Evaluation Methods for Scientific Instruments
venue: PEARC '26 (Practice and Experience in Advanced Research Computing)
summary: Evaluation methods for experimental cyberinfrastructure, drawn from 10 years of Chameleon operations. I led the publications analysis, combining Google Scholar, Scopus and Semantic Scholar with user reports to trace about 1,200 publications to the platform, and managed the submission. With K. Keahey, P. Marshall, M. Powers, M. Sherman and D. Stanzione.

title: The Cost of Teaching Operational ML
summary: From FOUNT: a large MLOps course taught on Chameleon, the AWS and GCP cost of the same resources, and the tradeoffs of teaching on commercial versus research clouds.

title: Chameleon Concierge: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) To Enhance Open Testbed Documentation
summary: Poster on Chameleon Concierge, the RAG documentation assistant I scoped and supervised, co-authored with the summer student who built the first prototype.

title: Summer of Reproducibility: Building Global Capacity for Practical Reproducibility through Hands-On Mentorship
venue: ACM Conference on Reproducibility and Replicability (ACM REP '25)
summary: On REPETO's mentorship program, which paired 55+ students with 60+ mentors on reproducibility challenges. With S. Lieggi, F. Fund and K. Keahey.

title: How Wi-Fi Bottlenecks Affect Home Access Networks
summary: Documents home network performance and where in-home Wi-Fi, rather than the broadband connection, becomes the bottleneck.

title: Scaling Edge Computing: Lessons from Real Device Deployments
summary: Describes the FLOTO architecture and what it took to deploy and operate a national fleet of measurement devices.
